description: This file defines the AreaChartRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering area charts within the PDFsharp library featuring charting capabilities. It includes methods for initializing rendering info, formatting layout, and drawing the chart elements such as axes, legend, gridlines, and plot area. The class inherits from ColumnLikeChartRenderer and interacts with various other renderer classes and chart components.

classes.name: AreaChartRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for creating area charts in the PDFsharp charting library, handling layout, initialization, and drawing of chart components.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the renderer-specific information required to render the chart, including axes, legend, plot area, and chart data.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout and positions for chart elements, preparing the chart for rendering.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Performs the actual drawing of the chart, including axes, legend, gridlines, plot area, and walls.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Prepares the series data for rendering by creating SeriesRendererInfo objects for each data series.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Initializes styling and point data for each series in the chart.
